---
title: "Data Set"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)

# Load data
kimball <- read_csv(
  "data/kimball.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>  
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x != ""))

# Transform data (adapted from your template)
kimball <- kimball |> 
  mutate(
    parsed_date = suppressWarnings(mdy(date)),
    date = if_else(
      !is.na(parsed_date),
      paste(
        day(parsed_date),
        month(parsed_date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
        year(parsed_date)
      ),
      date
    )
  ) |> 
  arrange(parsed_date)

# Table
reactable(
  kimball,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  searchable = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    id = colDef(name = "ID"),
    accession = colDef(name = "Accession"),
    locator = colDef(name = "Locator"),
    site = colDef(name = "Site"),
    type = colDef(name = "Type"),
    author = colDef(name = "Author"),
    date = colDef(name = "Date"),
    format = colDef(name = "Format"),
    size = colDef(name = "Size"),
    description = colDef(name = "Description"),
    notes = colDef(name = "Notes"),
    issues = colDef(name = "Issues")
  )
)
```
